props.author: KillaXBT
props.text:
Kinda funny, init? The biggest $BTC long liquidations on 10/10 marked the top. The biggest short liquidations on 19/08 marked the bottom.

But sure, keep coping. The desperation for lower at this point is laughable.

— I listened to absolutely fucking nobody apart from myself. Never mistake confidence for ego. A trader is naturally going to be confident in their own plan.
